sequencing_records.note: runs are sequencing records of the same library, not additional mice

experiment1_library_accounting.note: no deposit or public record explains the 13-versus-10 difference

biological_pool_id.consequence: library estimates are descriptive; no biological p values

reporter_pair_id.consequence: RFP/YFP same-r libraries are not treated as paired mice

independence_verified.consequence: minimum two lungs pooled per library (paper); pool overlap between libraries unknown

author_cell_annotation.consequence: EN1 clustering is source-inspired, never an author-label reproduction

reporter_features_in_matrix.consequence: reporter identity is library metadata only; no per-cell reporter call

spatial_mouse_and_clone_ids.consequence: joint mouse-level spatial analysis (EN6c) stays unavailable

trial_verdicts.EN1: run-ready (source-inspired clustering, per experiment; no six-state target)
trial_verdicts.EN2: run-ready as descriptive library contrasts; within-state estimates only where >=30 cells per library
trial_verdicts.EN3: run-ready; snapshot RNA, no activity or duration inference
trial_verdicts.EN4: limited: 2-week Confetti-YFP is a single baseline library; 4-day arm has no matched baseline
trial_verdicts.EN5_CD177: run-ready where transition-gated groups reach 30 cells on both Cd177 sides; otherwise unavailable
trial_verdicts.EN6_simulation: run-ready from verified archive; EN6c spatial joint analysis blocked (no IDs)
trial_verdicts.EN7: run-ready as descriptive transfer (Choi pooled libraries; Niethamer 25-sample atlas, known days)
